verified_facts.text: Rosewood Mandarina is in Riviera Nayarit, Mexico.
Accommodation is all suites, with views over the natural terrain of Riviera Nayarit.
verified_facts.excerpt: All-suite accommodations offer full immersion into the natural terrain of Riviera Nayarit.

verified_facts.text: The suites have views of the ocean, the flatlands and the mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: With sweeping views of the ocean, flatlands, and mountains that transform with the sunlight, the suites at Rosewood Mandarina evoke the natural splendor of the surrounding landscape.

verified_facts.text: Each specialty suite has living and dining space and a private plunge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: each suite has generous living and dining space, a relaxing private plunge pool and much more.

verified_facts.text: The premium villas are the most spacious accommodation in the resort, with indoor and outdoor space suited to families and small groups.
verified_facts.excerpt: The most spacious in the resort, offering expansive indoor and outdoor space perfect for families, small groups of friends, or entertaining the most important people in your life.

verified_facts.text: La Cocina Mandarina is the all-day restaurant, built around a traditional comal that makes handmade tortillas.
verified_facts.excerpt: is our all-day dining restaurant anchored by a traditional comal producing handmade tortillas.

verified_facts.text: Buena Onda is a casual beach shack serving Spanish coastal food: grilled seafood, tapas and paellas.
verified_facts.excerpt: A casual beach shack serving a Spanish coastal menu of grilled seafood, tapas, and paellas

verified_facts.text: Barra Peñasco is an open-air bar perched on a cliff among ancient fig trees, with cocktails, Mexican spirits and live music at sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched on a cliff among ancient fig trees, Barra Peñasco is an open-air bar where cocktails, Mexican spirits, and live music come alive with the setting sun over the horizon.

verified_facts.text: Toppu combines Japanese technique with Mexican flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Toppu blends the precision of Japanese technique with vibrant Mexican flavors

verified_facts.text: The Polo & Equestrian Club sits on the flatlands beneath the Sierra Madre peaks, where guests of all ages can ride, learn or watch seasonal polo matches.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on Mandarina’s lush flatlands beneath the Sierra Madre peaks, the Polo & Equestrian Club invites guests of all ages to ride, learn, or watch seasonal polo matches.

verified_facts.text: Mandarina Golf Club is a 9-hole par-3 course designed by Greg Norman, with mountain views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Greg Norman, the 9-hole par-3 course unfolds across Mandarina’s green flatlands, offering dramatic mountain views and an unforgettable challenge hole.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a panga to the Islas Marietas, a protected National Reserve of uninhabited islands, to spot rare birds and see Playa del Amor beneath a crater.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Islas Marietas is a group of uninhabited islands and a protected National Reserve. Take a panga across the water, spot rare birds and discover the Playa del Amor, a private beach beneath a breathtaking crater.

verified_facts.text: Summer activities include sea turtle releases and ocean adventures.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into a season of ocean adventures, sea turtle releases, and meaningful moments immersed in Mandarina’s natural beauty.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers an Agave Experience on tequila, mezcal, sotol and other agave spirits with its Head Tequilero.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the world of the agave plant and its spirits — tequila, mezcal, sotol, and more — with our talented Head Tequilero.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take a Mexican cooking class on ancestral techniques with the culinary team.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn ancestral Mexican cooking techniques alongside our talented culinary team.

verified_facts.text: Private dinners can be set on the beach by torchlight.
verified_facts.excerpt: The ocean breezes warm your skin, torches provide the lighting, and the stars twinkle overhead as you indulge in a moonlit culinary experience by the sea.

verified_facts.text: Menus use ingredients from a network of local producers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our menus use the freshest ingredients from our network of local producers.

verified_facts.text: Buena Onda is a beachfront spot at the base of the mountain, by the Pacific.
verified_facts.excerpt: A beachfront oasis at the mountain’s base, this casual shack serves Spanish coastal fare—grilled seafood, tapas, paellas—with cocktails and sangria by the Pacific.

subjective.text: Specialty suites offer some of Riviera Nayarit's most captivating views.
